content: Microsoft Graph GET /drives/{id}/items/{id}/content returns HTTP 302 Found with a Location header pointing at a preauthenticated download URL - the same value as the @microsoft.graph.downloadUrl property on driveItem. Official wording: 'Preauthenticated download URLs are valid for a limited time. Use them immediately, as they might expire within minutes. You don't need to include an Authorization header when you access the download URL.' Request it explicitly with GET /drive/items/{id}?select=id,@microsoft.graph.downloadUrl. Partial range downloads: the Range header MUST be appended to the @microsoft.graph.downloadUrl request, not to /content.
